question: Should WebChat edits be immutable branch-and-reprocess operations only, or should the product also permit save-only mutation of persisted conversation history?
rationale: The two requested modes have materially different transcript integrity, history visibility, and agent-context consequences; current reply-context work does not establish this contract.

options.title: Branch-only edits
options.body: Treat edits and regeneration as a new branch from the selected user turn, preserving the original transcript unchanged.

options.title: Allow save-only transcript mutation
options.body: Permit typo-only edits in place, with explicit audit and UI semantics for changed historical content.

options.title: Defer until session-history policy is defined
options.body: Keep the request open but do not add WebChat UI or gateway parameters until the durable history model is agreed.

recommendation.title: Branch-only edits
recommendation.body: Treat edits and regeneration as a new branch from the selected user turn, preserving the original transcript unchanged.
